variants.name: A · Apricot Moments
variants.detail: Variant A · Apricot Moments. Closest to Mori chosen Apricot, but clean flat cream surfaces rather than paper. Palette warm ivory #FFF8ED, cards #FFFCF6, apricot support #FFE4CC, coral primary #E96B50 with dark cocoa #352C29 text and subtle 3px darker bottom edge. 24px radii, friendly Nunito-like headings. CAPTURE-FIRST composition: short warm apricot panel under heading asking 'What would you like to remember?' primary Add a memory and secondary Record a voice with small friendly rounded camera/microphone illustration confined to panel right. Beneath, 2-column recent memories desktop with dominant landscape photograph card and adjacent short story/voice rows; compact capsule banner lower down. Mobile has compact prompt panel then recent photo then voice row visible before bottom navigation; no overly giant hero. Warm welcoming but grown-up. Outside heading exactly 'A · Apricot Moments'.
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one polished high-resolution horizontal design comparison board, approximately 2400x1600. This is a NEW Everlittle authenticated private family archive web app design concept, not Mori and not a marketing landing page. Show a large complete desktop app viewport on LEFT (about 70% board width), and a complete readable mobile app viewport on RIGHT (about 25% width), on a restrained matching studio background. Small outside-board heading for variant name, no explanatory paragraphs. All UI text crisp and legible. Desktop content useful at realistic 1440px, mobile at realistic 390px; screen mockups front-on, no tilt/perspective. Desktop and mobile are responsive versions of SAME home screen. Reference images 1-2 supply rounded warm visual language only: do not copy their fox, manga art, literal wooden shelf or heavy textures. Reference image 3 is existing Everlittle sprout brand; retain this sprout symbol beside wordmark Everlittle, no new mascot. All family photographs fictional US family, natural photography, not manga. Same sample archive for comparison: Emma, parent Sarah Parker. Main page heading 'Emma’s memories', subtitle 'The little things, kept together.' Main action '+ Add a memory'. Desktop top horizontal nav exactly 'Parent', 'Timeline', 'Capsules', 'Child', 'Family', with Parent selected. Mobile bottom nav same five labels TEXT ONLY, zero icons, spacious consistent targets, does not cover content. No game stats, points, streaks, trophy icons, pressure messaging, invented new features. Existing memory types Photo, Story, Voice, Video, Milestone available through clear capture flow; do not fit all five tiny labels across mobile. Include recent photo 'A rainy afternoon together' with warm photo of a mother and young child at kitchen table; story 'Things you say' text 'When I grow up, I’m going to be a cloud painter.'; voice 'Grandpa’s bedtime story' with real-looking variable-height static waveform and play control, duration '1:34'; capsule 'For your 18th birthday', 'Opens May 14, 2039'. Consistent rounded humanist sans in all UI, medium body weights, bold only headings and primary action, readable 16px equivalent body, large 44px+ touch targets. Cream or dark high contrast text as suitable. Practical aligned layouts; no rotated notes, torn paper, tape, handwriting, serif, paper stacks, ornamental folded corners, confetti, floating icons. Visual softness comes from proportion, rounded corners, inviting palette, subtle tactile button bottom edge and friendly icon forms.

variants.name: B · Gentle Green
variants.detail: Variant B · Gentle Green. Strongest practical everyday option, independently designed composition. Warm off-white #F7F9F4 page, white cards, muted sage #E4EEDD selection fills, forest #27624C primary with warm white labels, cocoa-charcoal #29352F text, very limited pale butter accent. Rounded Nunito-like type but restrained, soft 20px corners, subtle 2px button base, fine tinted outlines and little shadow. FEED-FIRST composition. Desktop top heading with search field for existing memories and Add a memory action; below content wide main chronological feed left 65%, compact right column with capture shortcuts and upcoming capsule. The feed has date header 'September 2026', medium landscape photo with caption, then clean compact voice and story entries all on consistent white surfaces. Small kind icons and labels replace decorative different paper shapes. Mobile header Emma’s memories, Add a memory full-width forest button, horizontal filter 'All  Photos  Stories  Voice' below, then photo card and compact voice card; entire bottom nav visible. Show story as desktop feed entry. Keep all real memory content dominant, no illustration hero. Outside heading exactly 'B · Gentle Green'.

variants.name: C · Memory Library
variants.detail: Variant C · Memory Library. Album-focused visual approach inspired by Mori's library emphasis but no fake bookshelf or wood. Calm buttercream #FFFCF2 background, sky-blue #DFECF7 grouped areas, warm amber #F3BD64 buttons with deep navy #26364A labels, navy ink, a little peach for selected chip. Rounded humanist typography, exceptionally clean 24px corners with tactile buttons. BROWSE-FIRST composition. Desktop horizontal nav, heading and Add a memory, then a broad sky-tinted overview with one large PHOTO memory preview at left and right a narrow stack of Voice and Story memory cards, each clearly labeled; below use a tidy horizontal 'September 2026' date grouping and a distinct rounded capsule panel with simple envelope icon. It should feel like a family media library: neatly framed images, consistent metadata placement, obvious search near header and filter chips for All, Photos, Stories, Voice, Videos, Milestones on desktop. Mobile simplifies into a photo-first single-column library, search compact, 2 filter chips plus All visible, prominent photo card, compact voice row, amber Add a memory action near title, text-only navigation. Existing functionality only, no new collections or automatic AI groupings implied. Very little ornament. Outside heading exactly 'C · Memory Library'.
